race.comment: KEN'KER (1) sets the standard in a Benchmark 50 where exposed recent form looks the safest guide. He was beaten as favourite at Kempsey, but the margin was under four lengths, he had jumped awkwardly, and his record at this distance reads well enough to give him another strong chance. ENZONI (7) is the immediate danger after finishing third at Kempsey, beaten a length and a half, and he also has the relevant edge over NARUKAMI from that meeting. NARUKAMI (3) has the upside of a Port Macquarie Maiden win two runs back, though his fifth behind Jeunetos last start left him with a rebound to make. RELEASETHEWOLVES (6) is also in the mix.
